15. REMOVE GLOVE COMPARTMENT PANEL
(a) Remove the two screws and door lock striker.
(b) Remove the two screws and a clip.
(c) Remove the light from the panel and remove the panel.

16. REMOVE COWL RH SIDE TRIM
Remove the nut and trim.

17. REMOVE FOOT REST
Remove two screws and the rest.

18. REMOVE COWL LH SIDE TRIM
Remove the nut and the side trim.

19. REMOVE GLOVE COMPARTMENT DOOR REINFORCEMENT
Remove the two screws, bolt and reinforcement.

20. REMOVE GLOVE COMPARTMENT DOOR COURTESY SWITCH
